summary: The second SDD session did what the story asked. It loaded hyperpowers:subagent-driven-development, created its own worktree, and ran `sdd-state next`, which named Task 2 as the only claimable task. It then registered on the plan, claimed Task 2, and implemented, reviewed and merged it. It never took over Task 1 and never asked the developer about Task 1. At the end it handed back because Task 3 still needs Task 1, which fixture-session holds.
reasoning: All five criteria are met, with evidence from the session log JSONL and the ledger progress.md. The held-task rule worked: the agent took the claimable Task 2, did not stop on Task 1 and did not take it over, then handed back properly at the dependency wait. The worktree-guard friction is a real problem but did not block the scenario.

observations.description: Launch had several onboarding dialogs: theme, security notes, folder trust, a "Newer Opus model available" prompt, and bypass-permissions. The model prompt said "Currently pinned: Opus 5" even though the launcher passes --model claude-opus-5-5. On my first launch an extra Enter landed on "No, exit" in the bypass dialog and Claude quit, so I had to relaunch. The banner then showed Opus 5.5 · Google Vertex AI.

The worktree isolation guard refused many ordinary commands: chained `git switch --detach feature/parallel && ...`, `git checkout --detach feature/parallel`, and printf/cat heredocs (messages like "feeds git its arguments from stdin at runtime (xargs/parallel)" and "construct too complex to verify"). The word "parallel" in the branch name appears to trip the xargs/parallel check. The agent worked around it by detaching to the commit SHA and splitting commands up, which cost time.

The agent guessed that "the guard seems to trip on the word 'parallel' in the branch name" and tried `refs/heads/feature/para""llel`, quote-splitting the word to get past the guard. That is mild guard-evasion behavior worth reviewing.
`sdd-state verify` returned "status=ok tasks=0" even though fixture-session already had Task 1 claimed. That may be correct (no completed tasks), but the output is ambiguous.
The Task 2 commit message has no blank line before the Co-Authored-By trailer, so the one-line subject reads "feat: b Co-Authored-By: ...". The agent noticed this and deferred it as a minor issue.

The final hand-back was clear. It showed the board (held=1@fixture-session, waiting=3), said why the session stopped, and told me how to continue. It also included a long note on installing the Codex plugin, which isn't related to the task.

criteria.evidence: The first tool_use in session log 8914cbf6-ca29-4de9-939a-5349b6d9acfb.jsonl is `Skill: hyperpowers:subagent-driven-development`. The screen showed "⏺ Skill(hyperpowers:subagent-driven-development) ⎿ Successfully loaded skill" before any other work.

criteria.criterion: Ran sdd-state register and sdd-state next; next names Task 2
criteria.evidence: Both Bash commands are in the log. `sdd-state next docs/hyperpowers/plans/parallel.md --session 8914cbf6-...` returned "status=next tasks=2 own-blocked=none plan=1a6af3e". `sdd-state register ... --integration feature/parallel` returned "status=registered integration=feature/parallel plan-ref=feature/parallel". Note: the standalone `next` ran before `register`; an earlier combined command attempt was blocked by the worktree guard.

criteria.criterion: Claimed Task 2 with --session and worked it; ledger has Task 2: branch line
criteria.evidence: The command `sdd-state claim docs/hyperpowers/plans/parallel.md 2 --session 8914cbf6-ca29-4de9-939a-5349b6d9acfb` returned "status=claimed task=2 branch=feature/parallel.43d696ad.task-2 from=f391771". progress.md contains "Task 2: branch feature/parallel.43d696ad.task-2 from f391771" and later "Task 2: complete (commits f391771..1a77cdc, review clean)".

`jq -r '... tool_use | .input.command' <log> | grep -c -- '--takeover'` returned 0. The word appears in the log file only in skill text, not in any command. The final message says: "I haven't taken Task 1 over and won't unless you tell me to."

criteria.criterion: Did not stop at held Task 1 before taking Task 2
criteria.evidence: Between the `next` output (tasks=2) and the claim, the agent only did setup (register, verify, deps, plan read, pre-flight scan, snapshot) and wrote "Pre-flight scan is clean... then claiming Task 2." There was no question or hand-back to me in that span. I sent no input after the first prompt.
